answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 10 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 980 identities costs 980 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. A plume of doubt is healthy, a yarrow of proof is required, and a walnut of patience is the price of a clean panel.
